verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an official MCP server. None of the evidence mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions, and the API-scope description lists no webhook surface. Webhooks are a fair question for an API-enabled SaaS, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
